name: NO_STOPPING_WHEN_LIGHTS_FLASHING_WHITE_TALL

r5-35_no_standing_140.desc: AS 1743 no-stopping roundel 140 dia (R5-36), as the sheet cites

notes: DIT SA Standard Road Sign Index sheet (A4, legends and dimensions outlined, colour legend; size from the sheet's size table = register). Every dimension from the sheet; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. R5-SA165 225 x 450 (2015, 1:5), R25, white, no border. No-stopping roundel R5-36 (140 dia), 30 from the top, centred — the national symbol. WHEN / LIGHTS / FLASHING 35 C red, baselines 240 (170 + 70) / 300 / 360; widths 102 (61/102/61), 126 (49/126/49), 180 (22/180/22). Arrow centre line 45 below (y 405), 45 from the bottom: 35/155/35. Arrows are the AS 1743 R5-14 (double, 155 x 32) and R5-16 (single, 125 x 32) open-chevron arrows the sheet cites, drawn as polygons with the national dimensions (shaft 12, head 42 long x 32 wide, barbs 12 thick).
